conclusions.text: The exact pinned simplified geoBoundaries product contains 159 features, and all eight scoped components intersect at least one feature; one is covered by the product union and seven are not. These are CRS84 product-relative diagnostics and do not establish authority, dry land, water, or ownership.
The historical MyGOS response was not retained. Besut validity and overlay findings remain preliminary and unverified; service CRS/datum handling, currentness, and reuse are unresolved.
The three numeric-closure component IDs, source lineage to the current display derivative, exact legally effective Terengganu geometry, and dated physical/water classification remain unknown.

The pinned DOSM data-open GeoJSON and repository Open Data License are retained. A bounded comparison finds eight scoped components intersecting valid source features (12 component-feature intersections total); all eight complete-union coverage results remain unassessed because the full product contains seven invalid geometries. Fresh two-run receipts for vintage 20261007-dosm-r5 bind the retained source, exact producer/helpers, runtime module-origin fingerprints, adverse controls, and immutable manifest snapshot. The comparison is product-relative only: upstream lineage, observation vintage, accuracy, and third-party rights remain unresolved; no legal authority, physical class, cause, or ownership is inferred.
